description: MAZ-96 baseline of axe violations found when the scans were added (Chromium 1248, axe-core 4.14; Firefox and WebKit are held to the same layout's entries, minus any `except`). Every entry is an open accessibility gap listed in docs/development/acceptance.md; remove it when fixed. The scan fails on any violation not listed here and on any listed one that no longer occurs.

violations.reason: Design-kit colors below 4.5:1 for normal text: white on the accent button (3.68 light, 2.76 dark), income green (3.69-4.17), pending amber (3.16-3.64), keyboard-shortcut chips and quiet links (4.41-4.43), banner text (4.13). Needs a design-kit token change (MAZ-122 visual handoff), not a hand edit of tokens.css.
